report:
Findings:  There is a mild knee effusion. A mild fluid-filled Baker's cyst is noted.  There is incomplete tearing of the posterior root of the medial meniscus with partial extrusion of the medial meniscus from the joint. Myxoid degeneration of the posterior body and posteromedial corner of the medial meniscus is noted. Normal lateral meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  There is evidence of subchondral impaction fracturing of the weightbearing aspect of the medial femoral condyle with surrounding marrow edema. Diffuse marrow edema is also seen in the whole of the medial femoral condyle. Mild diffuse marrow edema is also seen in the medial tibial condyle. Mild thinning of the medial compartment articular cartilage is noted.  Normal lateral compartment articular cartilage. Moderate generalized thinning of the patellofemoral articular cartilage is noted with severe thinning and loss of the lateral patellofemoral articular cartilage and underlying bony change. 
 Conclusion: Changes associated with subchondral insufficiency fracturing of the knee (SIFK). Incomplete tearing of the posterior root of the medial meniscus with myxoid degeneration of the posterior medial meniscus. Moderate - severe patellofemoral degeneration noted.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Obs. Meniscopatía.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Transformación quística parcial del LCA, sin signos de rotura. LCP y ligamentos colaterales dentro
de límites normales.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y cuerpo del menisco medial que no impresiona
contactar con la superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de una rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Úlcera
condral focal de espesor total de la faceta medial de la rótula, sin cambios óseos secundarios.
Condropatía superficial del resto del cartílago rotuliano.
No hay signos de derrame articular o sinovitis.
Leve aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital, sin signos de rotura. Tendón
rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales.
Impresión:
Transformación quística parcial del LCA.
Condropatía focal grado 3 de la faceta medial de la rótula.
Condropatía superficial del resto de la rótula.
Leve tendinosis cuadricipital distal

MRI of Right Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS

* Increase interstitial intensity of ACL and proximal PCL with straight linear contour suspect degenerative change
* Heterogenous hypertintensity and medial displacement(Srs:[ID] Img:9) of anterior horn of lateral meniscus with subcondromaedema(Srs [ID] Img:12) in the lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau suspect bucket handle tear 
* A lobulated cystic lesion in medial popliteal fossa between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of Baker's cyst.
* Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis. Mild deep infrapatellar and suprapatellar fat stranding; Wearing articular cartilage of femoral condyle
* Hyperintensity of popliteal muscle on F/S T2WI, suspect edema
* Honycombing hyperintensity in the subcutaneous layer of anterior knee on F/S T2WI suspect edema
* Fusiform dilatation of branches of popliteal vein(Srs:[ID]:15-19) in the posterior medial aspect of knee joint, cause to be determined
* A 14mm x 9mm x 15mm in size, well-defined, and oval-shpaed lesion in the subcutaneous layer of lateroanterior aspect of knee joint(Srs: [ID]: 13) showed mild hyperintensity on F/S T2WI and F/S PD, hypo- to isointensity on T1WI, suspect focal fat necrosis or small subcutanoue nodule.
> Prescence of anterior and posterior meniscofemoral ligaments
> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of  grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration.

Impression:
1. Suspect bucket handle tear of anterior horn of lateral meniscus; degeneration of medial meniscus 
2. Osteoarthritis of right knee joint, more severe at lateral compartment with synovitis, suprapatellar bursitis and patellar plicae.
3. Baker's cyst formation 
4. Fusiform dilatation of branches of popliteal vein in the posterior medial aspect of knee joint, R/O venous insufficiency.
5. Bone marrow edema of lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau, maybe due to degeneration with subchondral edema; differential diagnosis of bone contusion.
6. Suspect  popliteal muscle edema
6. Suspect degenerative change of ACL and PCL
7. Subcutaneous edema of anterior knee 
8. A 14mm x 9mm x 15mm lesion in the subcutaneous layer of lateroanterior aspect of knee joint R/O focal fat necrosis or small subcutanoue nodule.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Moderate left knee joint effusion joint effusion, with a moderate to large sized popliteal cyst, measuring 2.6 x 1.9 x 7.9 cm, with some linear fluid extending distal to the cyst along the medial aspect of the medial head of gastrocnemius suggesting rupture or leak from the cyst.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
There is a multidimensional tear involving the body of the medial meniscus, which appears attenuated with an associated flipped fragment extending to the superior aspect of the medial joint recess. The body of the medial meniscus is extruded. The tear extends at least 2 cm from anterior to posterior. This represents an unstable meniscal tear.

Diffuse articular cartilage thinning is identified involving the weightbearing surface of the medial femoral condyle without significant subchondral bone marrow reactive signal intensity changes.

The medial collateral ligament is intact.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Normal.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
Normal.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
There is moderate focal chondrosis with significant thinning focally of the articular cartilage over the medial patellar facet without any underlying bone marrow signal intensity abnormality.

There is severe diffuse thinning and irregularity involving the trochlear articular cartilage, with associated subchondral bone marrow reactive signal intensity changes which are most marked involving the central and lateral trochlea.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
None

CONCLUSION:
1.Unstable tear involving the body of the medial meniscus with extrusion of the meniscus and associated flipped fragment from the meniscus, as described.
2.Medial femorotibial compartment and patellofemoral compartment chondrosis, as described.
3.Moderate left knee joint effusion and moderate to large sized popliteal cyst with appearances suggesting some rupture/leak of fluid from the popliteal cyst distally.

Findings: There is a minor knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  Minor thinning of the medial compartment articular cartilage is noted. The lateral tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage is normal.  There is mild - moderate thickening and edema of the superomedial aspect of the prominent suprapatellar fat pad.  
Conclusion: Superomedial suprapatellar fat pad edema. No meniscal tear. Minimal effusion.

Diz eklemindeki trikompartmantal dejeneratif eklem hastalığı lateral femoral tibyal kompartmanda en belirgin ve tam kata ulaşan eklem kıkırdağı kaybı ve dejenerasyonu, subkondral medüller fibrokistik ve fibrovasküler değişiklikler ve marjinal osteofitlerle karakterize. Lateral tibyal plato posterolateral köşede minimal deplase akut-subakut evredeki kırığı ve medyal platoda orta hattaki subkondral kırığı geniş kemik iliği ödemi çevreliyor. Diz eklemi içi orta dereceli sıvı artışı yer yer 8 mm'ye varan sinovyal hipertrofi ile birlikte. Ön çapraz bağdaki difüz ödem parsiyel yırtığı ile birlikte. Arka çapraz bağ ve yan bağlar normal. Medyale 4 mm ekstrüde medyal menisküsün gövde kesiminde doku kaybının eşlik ettiği kompleks dejeneratif yırtık. Lateral menisküs arka boynuzu-gövde kesiminde üst eklem yüzeyi ile ilişkilenen yırtık izleniyor. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Gastrokinemyus-semimembranozus (GK-SM) bursiti 5,7x2,7x1,4 cm boyutunda olup sızdırıyor. Semimembranozus tendonunda insersiyonel tendonozis.

ΕΥΡΗΜΑΤΑ Από τον έλεγχο των χιαστών και πλαγίων συνδέσµων, του έσω µηνίσκου, του οστικού µυελού και του αρθρικού χόνδρου δεν παρατηρούνται αξιόλογα ευρήµατα. Ο έξω µηνίσκος έχει δισκοειδή µορφολογία.
